name: agy-call
description: agy-call: Gemini coding tasks and reviews from Claude Code through the agy (Antigravity) CLI, with a safe runner for every agy call.

plugins.name: agy
plugins.description: Slash commands for Gemini coding tasks in their own git worktree, reviews and adversarial reviews, with background jobs; every reply is saved, unusable replies are resumed in the same conversation, and a quota error stops all callers.
